Paso questions, answered.

729 12th St in downtown Paso Robles, near the Downtown City Park and the tasting rooms. Easy to reach on foot from the Spring Street shops.

Until midnight Sunday to Thursday and until 2:00 AM Friday and Saturday, so late-night pizza in Paso is covered on weekends.

Yes. Delivery and takeout cover Paso Robles, Templeton, Santa Margarita and nearby areas. Order online for pickup or delivery.

The 28-inch pie, the biggest pizza in the area, feeds a whole tasting party. Add wings, a Caesar salad and tiramisu and the table is set.

Yes. The Ajarski, a warm bread boat with fresh mozzarella, feta and egg inspired by Georgian khachapuri, is baked in Paso too.
